OtoDock design reference

The tokens, the type, the scales and the primitives of the dashboard, in both themes. Generated: edit design/tokens.json and run npm run tokens:build. Print it to get the reference document.

ColourPrimitivesContrastTypeThe markIconographyComponentsLayout and spacingElevationMotion

Type

Comfortaa for the wordmark and headings at text-lg and larger, Manrope for every other string, JetBrains Mono for code and the terminal. The faces load from the dashboard's installed packages; without them the fallbacks show.

font-display Comfortaa, Manrope, ui-rounded, system-ui, sans-serif
The wordmark, page titles and headings at text-lg and larger, never at label sizes.

Iconography

Inline outline SVGs in the dashboard's own style: a 24-unit box, stroke 1.75, round caps and joins, currentColor, shown at 16 and 20 px. No icon package.

chat 16chat 20settings 16settings 20agents 16agents 20bell 16bell 20file 16file 20

Card
